title: Handoff envelope (input and output) shared by every IDE specialist
description: Spec: REPO-DESIGN.md §5.2. The parent passes only a prompt string to a subagent, so the orchestrator renders the INPUT envelope ($defs.input) into the handoff prompt as a fenced JSON block (templates in .claude/skills/sdlc/references/handoff-prompts.md). The specialist's final message is EXACTLY the OUTPUT envelope ($defs.output) as one fenced JSON block; the orchestrator never extracts JSON from prose. ./scripts/sdlc apply validates the output against $defs.output, then validates `payload` against sdlc/agents/contracts/<agent>.schema.json#/$defs/output, then checks every file path and patch against sdlc/lifecycle/touch-sets.yaml. An invalid output is asked for once more; a second invalid output opens GX. Two agents do not use this envelope: tines-builder (its report is saved verbatim as build-log.md, never parsed) and tines-reviewer (its output is the reused .claude/skills/tines-review/references/findings-schema.json, accepted as-is with --schema findings). Names only: no credential value, token, email address or tenant hostname may appear anywhere in an envelope.

story_key.description: The slug: the folder under stories/ and sdlc/work/, and the tracker key

phase.description: A phase from sdlc/lifecycle/state-machine.yaml (phases); checked by phase_enum_in_sync

kind.description: The input kind named in sdlc/lifecycle/dispatch-rules.yaml `inputs.<agent>` (intake_brief, discovery_note, library_catalog, tenant_config, manifest, design, eval_cases, export, story_meta, diff_range, retro, …)

path.description: A repository path, or a git range for kind diff_range (origin/main...HEAD). Specialists receive paths, never pasted content (P6)

sha256.description: The file's hash when the envelope was rendered, so a stale input is detectable; omitted for a directory or a git range

entitlements.description: What the tenant actually bought, from kit/tenant/config.yaml — never assumed

finding.description: The same item shape as the reused .claude/skills/tines-review/references/findings-schema.json, so verify-merge treats every source alike

rule.description: A lint rule id (policies/lint-rules.yml), a /tines-review checklist letter, sec.N (security-reviewer), cost.N (the cost checks) or eval.case_failed (story-qa)

suggested_prompt.description: A ready /tines-build-story <slug> "<prompt>" whenever the fix is a story change; fixes never edit story.json

content.description: The whole file. apply writes it only when the path is inside the agent's touch set AND its phase's touch set

patch.description: An allow-listed structured edit (sdlc/lifecycle/touch-sets.yaml `patches`); apply applies it with yq and refuses any other file or path

set.description: A yq path inside the allow-list: .stories.<slug> · .stories.<slug>.dev.story_id · .agents."<slug>/<action>" · the story's own tracker row

value.description: The value written at that path (any JSON value)

input.description: Rendered by the orchestrator (./scripts/sdlc next --print-prompt in Cursor) into the handoff prompt

tracker_rev.description: The row's rev on the branch when the envelope was rendered

touch_set.description: The agent's entry in sdlc/lifecycle/touch-sets.yaml, with <slug> resolved; apply rejects an envelope whose touch set is wider

llm_choice.description: The Tines-side provider (REPO-DESIGN.md §10.1) — never the editor's model

max_turns.description: The agent's maxTurns; at the limit it returns verdict blocked with what is missing

rework.description: null, or the rework package (sdlc/templates/rework-package.schema.json) when the story is in build/rework; the builder's handoff points at .sdlc/out/<slug>/rework-<n>.json instead of inlining it

output.description: The specialist's final message, exactly, as one fenced JSON block

agent.description: The IDE specialist that produced it; selects sdlc/agents/contracts/<agent>.schema.json for the payload

verdict.description: done = the job is finished · changes_requested = a reviewer found a blocker or major (verify only) · needs_human = a question only a person can answer (needs_human is then set) · blocked = the specialist could not finish (max_turns, a missing input, an out-of-touch-set need); summary says what is missing

findings.description: Every finding this specialist raises, ordered blocker first; verify-merge reads findings from here (never from the payload)

payload.description: Agent-specific; validated against sdlc/agents/contracts/<agent>.schema.json#/$defs/output. The full payload ($defs.payload of that file) with verdict done or changes_requested; exactly {} with verdict needs_human or blocked (the allOf below)

next.description: A suggestion only; ./scripts/sdlc next and the state machine decide

model_tier.description: The tier the agent file declares (a comment beside model: inherit)

model_reported.description: As the client shows it, or "as the client shows it" when unknown; never a hard-coded id
